test_title: RRB ALP CBT-I 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 29 Nov, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: A, B, E, F, L, M and P are sitting around a circular table, facing the centre. Only three people sit between P and E when counted from the left of P. Only three people sit between M and A when counted from the right of A. L sits to the immediate right of M. F is an immediate neighbour of A as well as E. Who sits second to the left of B?
solution:
Given: A, B, E, F, L, M and P are sitting around a circular table, facing the centre. 

1) Only three people sit between P and E when counted from the left of P.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/41446b50977552a6e33d3f048c424a3cea4396b4f3816e16ed568cd7ef2ab621.png] 

2) F is an immediate neighbour of A as well as E.

3) Only three people sit between M and A when counted from the right of A.

As position of F with respect to E is not known yet, therefore there are two possible cases.

Case 1)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/977b5607cfdbc9114453ae02906cb5d04eac6217316c813a19be7450ac90f192.png] 

Case 2)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/219930072475cdf9641fc714f46dc6c37a313a4805c754db03eb2c734a19d9a2.png] 

4) L sits to the immediate right of M. 

As there is no possible position for L in case 2, therefore is eliminated.

After positioning L only one position is left which will be occupied by the only person left i.e. B.

Case 1)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0f3b2c749f9fe7eb22bb1c268acf78eb2fe87505536f546cafc4b122d1c3e9a3.png] 

Thus, according to the final arrangement, F sits second to the left of B.

Hence, "Option 1" is the correct answer.
